companies.name: WestRock (Smurfit WestRock)
companies.extraction: Server-rendered, plain curl/WebFetch works (verified without JS). Parse job cards for title, 'Job ID: ATR#####', location text, and the FolderDetail link (find via the visible 'Job ID' link href pattern /en_US/careers/FolderDetail/{slug}/{internal-id}).
companies.notes: CORRECTS the brief: post-merger, www.westrock.com now 301s to www.smurfitwestrock.com - the merger is complete, not 'in transition'. ATS is Avature (tenant smurfitwestrockta), not Workday. IMPORTANT GOTCHA: searching keyword 'Richmond' alone returns false positives from 'North Richmond' - a suburb of Sydney, Australia, where WestRock also has a plant (returned as e.g. 'Customer Service Manager, ANZ'). As of 2026-08-29, WestRock's actual Richmond, VA site ('VA Richmond Container') has only manufacturing-floor openings (forklift, converting, die cut, finance) - zero SWE/QA.

companies.name: Snagajob
companies.notes: www.snagajob.com is behind bot-protection that blocks plain curl (403) - had to use a JS-context browser fetch. Their own careers page's Angular app calls https://api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/snagajob/jobs to populate the 'Open positions' widget, and that call returns a live HTTP 404 - confirmed both by calling it directly and by watching Snagajob's OWN page throw the same 404 in its console. The board token 'snagajob' does not exist on Greenhouse's public API (tried several plausible token variants, all 404). This means Snagajob's careers page is currently not surfacing ANY open positions through its intended mechanism - not a scanner problem, a bug on their end. Recommend either dropping this company from the watch list or re-checking periodically by hand until they fix their board integration; there is currently no reliable automated method.

companies.name: Performance Food Group
companies.ats: Likely IBM Kenexa BrassRing behind a Radancy-style career site (job IDs follow BrassRing's 'NNNNNNBR' format; exact vendor not fully confirmed)
companies.extraction: Parse job cards for title, 'Job ID: NNNNNNBR', location, career area, and the /job/{slug}/{city-state}/{id}/ detail link.
companies.notes: jobs.performancefoodservice.com is behind bot-protection that blocks plain curl (403) - verified instead via a real browser render, which works fine and shows real listings, so a scanner needs a JS-capable/browser fetch for this one (plain WebFetch may also get blocked - test before relying on it). This board covers ALL Performance Food Group family brands (Performance Foodservice, Core-Mark, Vistar, Afflink, etc.) via a 'Division' facet, not just the Foodservice division the domain name suggests. Richmond, VA corporate HQ jobs are tagged Location Name 'West Creek-Richmond Corp (0999)' and Career Area 'Information Systems' - that facet is the right filter for SWE/QA-adjacent roles, NOT a free-text 'software engineer' keyword search (that returned 0 results even though real IT roles exist, because titles there run Network/Security/Service-Desk rather than 'engineer'). As of 2026-08-29, IT roles present are infra-flavored (Network Services Manager, Info Security Analyst, IT Service Desk Lead) - zero literal SWE/QA titles right now, but the mechanism and location are fully verified.
